model.name: Interactive-v2
model.pointsModel: position- and role-conditioned CatBoost mean and quantile regressors
model.quantiles: heuristic unconditional UI intervals; not calibrated decision intervals
model.optimizer: multi-matchday mixed-integer model solved with HiGHS
model.goalkeeperInsurance: three goalkeepers from one club in both roster phases
model.objective: sum of expected points from the best valid XI in every matchday with the season-specific position-preserving winter window
model.lineupEligibility: all selectable players; availability is priced into expected points
model.historicalMarketSnapshots: unavailable; validation is experimental until archived snapshots exist

validation.protocol: ensemble selected on one preseason validation season; final metrics use a later time-separated preseason holdout
validation.historicalMarketSnapshots: unavailable: completed-season metadata is not proven to be a decision-time snapshot, so these results must not be described as leakage-safe

0001.fallbackReason: CatBoost challenger did not beat the fixed-v1 champion on the later holdout
